semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Femtoscience Inc. provides plasma equipment and CVD processes relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Femtoscience Inc. manufactures plasma equipment and parylene coating systems used in semiconductor fabrication. Their products include both small-scale and large-scale plasma systems, with applications in surface treatment, etching, and coating processes. They offer unique chamber designs and effective vacuum plasma solutions for both research and commercial applications.
capabilities: Plasma equipment for surface treatment and etching
